title: The Design tool bar's Shape slot shows a rectangle until you pick another shape
goal: In the Design mode the UI mock draws the Shape tool as a square with the tip Shape (R). Photonz shows the shapes family's first member, the Line, until you have used another shape, so a person building a screen sees a line where the mock promises a rectangle.
notes: Found finishing design-mode-puts-the-ui-tool-strip-in-the-tool-b (2026-10-09). Seen in /tmp/photonz-playtest/design-mode-tool-strip-walk/1-design-tool-strip-sc.png. ToolGroup.shapes.tools is [.line, .rectangle, .ellipse]; member(from:) falls back to tools[0]. EditorState.swift:3912 reads the remembered member. Mock: ui-entry-wt.html tShape ic-square "Shape (R)".
acceptance: In a fresh Design mode window the Shape slot shows the Rectangle and its tip reads Rectangle (R) or Shape (R)
Once a person picks another shape the slot remembers it, as it does today
The picture tool bar outside Design keeps its own default

log.note: Reproduced on the old build: extended walk failed at hover Rectangle, on screen only Line. Fix: WindowMode.toolStripMembers (Design: shapes->rectangle), ToolGroup.member(from:startingWith:), EditorState keys the family memory per mode (tool.shapes.last.design) while the mode's strip is the bar; lastTool returns the tool in hand when it is of the family so a swap never shows a lit slot wearing another face. Choice: separate memories, so a Line drawn on a screenshot never puts a Line in Design. Tip wording (mock Shape (R) vs ours Rectangle R) went to a decision card on the-design-shape-slot-tip-reads-the-way-you-choo. Test suite green (12119), walk green with 15 real captures.

In Design the Shape slot now starts on the Rectangle (WindowMode.toolStripMembers) and remembers its own last shape; the picture bar keeps its Line. Reproduced first (walk failed: only Line on screen), then fixed. Tests green (12119, +5 in DesignModeToolStripTests); design-mode-tool-strip-walk green at Next defaults with real captures. Audit 2026-10-09-design-shape-slot-rectangle. Tip wording is on a decision card (the-design-shape-slot-tip-reads-the-way-you-choo). Commit bed976fc.
